title: MIDI Arp
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: An arpeggiator on each MIDI track, in time with the sequencer. SETTINGS: ARP TRACK (M1-M8) picks the track the next rows show; ARP MODE (OFF, UP, DOWN, UPDN, RND), ARP RATE (1/16, 1/8, 1/4), ARP OCT (1-3). A note trig's chord (NOTE and NOT2-NOT4) is arpeggiated until the track's next trig; a lock trig stops it. Notes held on the track (trig keys or MIDI in) are arpeggiated while the sequencer plays. Settings are saved. Needs seq-events. Its rows sit in the MOD SETTINGS section when that mod is in the build.
